### Relationships
The modification in `pxa-ssp.c` addresses a memory leak issue in the `pxa_ssp_probe` function. By changing the return statement to set an error code in `ret` and using a `goto` statement, the code allows for proper cleanup of allocated resources before exiting the function. This change ensures that if the probe fails, any previously allocated memory can be freed, thus preventing a memory leak.

        Root cause:
        The bug is caused by the failure to properly handle memory cleanup when the `pxa_ssp_probe` function encounters an error while trying to retrieve the 'port' phandle. The original code directly returns an error code without freeing any previously allocated resources, leading to a memory leak.
        
        Commit message:
        ASoC: pxa: pxa-ssp: small leak in probe()

There is a small memory leak if probe() fails.

Fixes: 2023c90c3a2c ('ASoC: pxa: pxa-ssp: add DT bindings')
Signed-off-by: Dan Carpenter <dan.carpenter@oracle.com>
Signed-off-by: Mark Brown <broonie@linaro.org>  
        
        Patch:
        diff --git a/sound/soc/pxa/pxa-ssp.c b/sound/soc/pxa/pxa-ssp.c
index 199a8b377553..0109f6c2334e 100644
--- a/sound/soc/pxa/pxa-ssp.c
+++ b/sound/soc/pxa/pxa-ssp.c
@@ -723,7 +723,8 @@ static int pxa_ssp_probe(struct snd_soc_dai *dai)
 		ssp_handle = of_parse_phandle(dev->of_node, "port", 0);
 		if (!ssp_handle) {
 			dev_err(dev, "unable to get 'port' phandle\n");
-			return -ENODEV;
+			ret = -ENODEV;
+			goto err_priv;
 		}
 
 		priv->ssp = pxa_ssp_request_of(ssp_handle, "SoC audio");
--
